synthesis.summary: VIX spiked 8.6% to 21.4, entering an explosive volatility regime supported by negative GEX (-$685M). While short-term ML models remain cautiously bullish, the confluence of rising volatility and negative gamma suggests significant instability.

synthesis.risk_flag: Negative Gamma (GEX) increases the risk of accelerated downside moves.
